children: CBOT wheat futures are now down 1.7%, after being off nearly 3% earlier. Wheat is generally lower on profit-taking, says Karl Setzer of Consus Ag Consulting. Traders settling books ahead of September is another factor. Helping pare the early losses are reports that Russian President Putin rejected a proposal for safe grain shipping lanes for wheat exports. Most-active corn is up 0.5%, while soybeans climb 0.2%.
